x: Part XII deals with Finance, Property, Contracts and Suits and covers Articles 264 to 300A (Article 300A now protects the right to property as a legal right). Articles 352-360 are in Part XVIII (Emergency), elections are in Part XV, and local government is in Parts IX and IXA.

Part XV (Elections) covers Articles 324 to 329A, not 352 to 360; Articles 352-360 form Part XVIII (Emergency). The other pairs are correct: Part XIVA (323A-323B) Tribunals, Part XII (264-300A) Finance, Property and Contracts, and Part XI (245-263) Union-State relations.
